capabilities: Hide empty property rows (empty strings, null, [], {}) in the Properties UI
Set Auto/Show/Hide visibility rules per note, folder, or vault with precedence
Reveal hidden properties via a temporary Show hidden properties (N) toggle
Reorder properties in the UI for a folder or vault without rewriting YAML
Assign decorative icons to properties from a searchable icon picker
extras: Screenshots were not yet included pending approval of a public UI capture; documentation is provided in English and Simplified Chinese. All visibility, reveal, and ordering changes are UI-only and never write to Markdown, except an explicit Delete from this note action.
intentEvidence: hides empty properties in the Properties UI while preserving Markdown and YAML frontmatter
motivation: Templates and structured note systems often contain many optional properties, and the author wanted those rows visually collapsed while keeping the underlying frontmatter intact.
problem: Templates and structured note systems leave many optional frontmatter properties empty, cluttering the Properties UI even though the values must be preserved.
summary: Properties-view helper that hides empty property rows in the editor UI with note, folder, and vault visibility rules, without touching YAML frontmatter.
